🚀 MAJOR UPDATE - Force Update Required

✨ What's New in v2.0.0:

Enhanced Search & Discovery:
• Smart search suggestions with recent searches
• Popular search recommendations
• Recent artists from your library
• Search history management
• Quick search filters

📚 Improved Library Organization:
• Advanced sorting options (Name, Artist, Date, Duration, Play Count)
• Smart filtering (Audio/Video, Downloaded/Imported)

• Better file organization
• Enhanced import functionality

• Fixed imported audio playback issues
• Improved queue system for playlists
• Enhanced mini player controls
• Better next/previous navigation
• Optimized splash screen timing

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements:
• Fixed bottom overflow in player screen
• Improved download progress handling
• Better error handling for downloads
• Enhanced app performance
• Smoother user experience

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is a force update required for new features to work properly.
